name: Annelieke Vermeer
bio:
Annelieke has always had an eye for detail, a trait that served her well from a young age when she began restoring classic bicycles with her grandfather. This passion for precision and aesthetics led her to pursue a career in automotive painting, where she quickly excelled. Her meticulous approach and dedication to achieving flawless finishes caught the attention of Tolman Motorsport, who headhunted her to lead their paint shop operations.

At Tolman, Annelieke is known for her ability to match any color perfectly, ensuring every car leaves the workshop looking its absolute best. She is constantly researching new paint technologies and application techniques to improve the quality and durability of their paint jobs. Her calm demeanor and collaborative spirit make her a valuable asset to the team, fostering a positive and productive work environment.

What sets Annelieke apart is her commitment to sustainability. She actively seeks out eco-friendly paint options and strives to minimize waste in the paint shop, demonstrating her dedication to both excellence and environmental responsibility.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, layered with subtle waves, often pulled back in a low ponytail during work.
physical.description: Annelieke has a kind face framed by her blonde hair, and a practical, no-nonsense air about her.

quirks: Always organizes paint samples by hue and saturation.
Listens to classical music while working to maintain focus.
Keeps a small succulent on her workbench for good luck.
